theme: An open Saturday — the shape of the day is yours.
greeting: Nothing sits on the calendar today, Dan. The only things wearing a clock are a couple of overdue bookings and tomorrow's quick board review with Mike.

needsAttention.title: Reply to the NACD Maine committee note
needsAttention.detail: A forwarded message reached your Gmail after bouncing off your old KPMG address — someone flagging interest in the NACD New England Maine Programming Committee and asking whether you got it. It wants a reply.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Maine Christmas SUV, refundable
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 task has been overdue since Sep 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out early — book it refundable now, adjust dates later.

needsAttention.title: Come to the Sunday review with the calls made
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow at 9 AM you and Mike clear the board in 15 minutes. Arrive holding the three that keep slipping: the Christmas SUV, the term-life quotes, and where the Pathfinder parks in Florida.

flagged.title: NACD Maine committee interest
flagged.detail: Forwarded note asking you to respond about the Maine Programming Committee — it bounced off your old KPMG address first, so a reply confirms you saw it.

flagged.title: AbeBooks sign-in attempt
flagged.detail: Sep 24 alert: a sign-in from an iPhone near Florida. Likely you, but worth a glance if not.

inbox.noise: The rest is an Airbnb referral, a BBYO reunion Evite, a LinkedIn job alert, and your daily Japanese lesson.

resolved.title: Moderating a panel at ICGN Toronto
resolved.detail: You accepted Elizabeth Thomas's invite to moderate; she confirmed and is sending speaker logistics and a pre-conference call.

recipe.title: Chicken, Sherry, Almond Pot Roast
recipe.why: A slow autumn braise for cooler evenings, when a warm pot on the stove earns its keep.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike

acts.line: An open Saturday with nothing on the calendar — the rare kind of morning to spend on the thing that's been waiting.
Still nothing scheduled; the only items with a real deadline are the overdue Christmas-rental and term-life bookings.
A quiet close, with tomorrow's 15-minute board review with Mike the one thing on deck.
